newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-K buys electric equipment maker.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-K buys electric equipment maker.

text.p: Polish construction company Mostostal Krakow SA paid 2.6 million zlotys for a 75 percent stake in electric equipment maker Energetyka-Czerwonak SA, the treasury ministry said in a statement on Wednesday.

The statement said that under the agreement signed with the ministry, Mostostal would invest another 1.3 million zlotys within the next two years in the company, based in the western town of Czerwonak.

The statement also said Mostostal would increase Energetyka-Czerwonak's employment by 10 percent within the next two years and maintain wages in the firm at least on the current level in real terms and find new markets for the company.
